name: Hachi
source:
Nana's younger brother. He likes games. He is a student at Central Junior School.

He has a cute face, but is mature and stoic. He's amazed by his older sister's energy.

Older people love him.

"I wish I could play a game."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22703015]official website[/url]]
